translationRepairs: His son, the Accomplished Ancestor, whose name was Wugu.
His son, the Accomplished Ancestor, whose name was Wugunai.
The Chinese name is 烏古乃 (Wugunai); 'Wugu' drops the final syllable.
He was born in the xinyou year, the first year of Liao Taiping (1081).
He was born in the xinyou year, the first year of Liao Taiping (1021).
The Liao dispatched the Yelu Helin ya at the head of an army to reclaim the fugitives.
The Liao dispatched the linya Helu at the head of an army to reclaim the fugitives.
曷魯林牙 is the name Helu plus the Liao title linya; 'Yelu Helin ya' fuses and corrupts both.
The Accomplished Ancestor had nine sons. His principal wife of the Tangut clan bore Hezhe, then the World Ancestor, Hesun, the Solemn Ancestor, and the Mournful Ancestor.
The Accomplished Ancestor had nine sons. His principal wife of the Tangkuo clan bore Hezhe, then the World Ancestor, Hesun, the Solemn Ancestor, and the Mournful Ancestor.
唐括氏 is the Jurchen Tangkuo clan, not the Tangut.
It was mid-autumn; rain fell day and night until the ground was sheeted in slush ice, and Wuchun’s army could not advance.
It was past the middle of the tenth month; rain fell day and night until the ground was sheeted in slush ice, and Wuchun’s army could not advance.
十月已半 means the tenth month was half over, not mid-autumn.
About a hundred men were killed, including the veteran chief Zhuba.
About a hundred men were killed, including the veteran chief Zhubao.
The Chinese name is 主保 (Zhubao).
A saying circulated in the tribe: “Want to live—follow Bahei; want to die—follow Helibo and Pilashi.”
A saying circulated in the tribe: “Want to live—follow Bahei; want to die—follow Helibo and Polashu.”
The Chinese name is 頗剌淑 (Polashu).
In the Accomplished Ancestor’s day Beinai of the Wanyan tribe had submitted; now he turned disloyal.
In the Accomplished Ancestor’s day Beinai of the Wole tribe had submitted; now he turned disloyal.
斡勒部 is the Wole tribe, not the Wanyan.
Chiefs Shazhi of the Pucha and Hubuda of the Hupuda sent Axi to plead for help; the World Ancestor bade him feign compliance to survive, saying: “In the fight, mark yourselves by flags and drums.”
The Pucha tribe chiefs Shazhi and Hubuda sent Axi to plead for help; the World Ancestor bade him feign compliance to survive, saying: “In the fight, mark yourselves by flags and drums.”
蒲察部沙祇勃堇、胡補答勃堇: both are bojin of the Pucha tribe; there is no 'Hupuda' tribe.
In the third year (1096), Bagge, chief of the Tangut tribe, was on familiar terms with Bate of the Wendu tribe; Bagge paid a visit on business and Bate killed him.
In the third year (1096), Bagge, chief of the Tangkuo tribe, was on familiar terms with Bate of the Wendu tribe; Bagge paid a visit on business and Bate killed him.
唐括部 is the Jurchen Tangkuo tribe, not the Tangut.
Liu-ke and Zhadu of the Wanyan at the Tongmen–Hunchun confluence, with Dikude of the Subin Wanyan, rose at Milimishi Han City; Dun’en, son of Nagennie, fled as well—and the two factions were at war.

Liu-ke and Zhadu of the Wugulun at the Tongmen–Hunchun confluence, with Dikude of the Subin Wugulun, rose at Milimishi Han City; Dun’en, son of Nagennie, fled as well—and the two factions were at war.
烏古論部 is the Wugulun tribe, not the Wanyan.

Before the envoys arrived, the Mournful Ancestor sent Wulin’a Shilu to aid Hezhe with this warning: “When the Liao come to halt the siege, swap our troops’ dress and banners for those of the garrison so the envoys cannot tell friend from foe—keep them in the dark.”

Before the envoys arrived, the Mournful Ancestor sent Wulinda Shilu to aid Hezhe with this warning: “When the Liao come to halt the siege, swap our troops’ dress and banners for those of the garrison so the envoys cannot tell friend from foe—keep them in the dark.”
烏林答 is the Wulinda clan name.
The Mournful Ancestor proclaimed that he was clearing the hawk route, hunted on the Tumen River, and returned.
The Mournful Ancestor proclaimed that he was clearing the hawk route, hunted on the Tuwen River, and returned.
土溫水 is the Tuwen River, not the Tumen.
In the third year of Liao Qianyuan (1103) he inherited the military commissionership, aged forty-three.
In the third year of Liao Qiantong (1103) he inherited the military commissionership, aged forty-three.
乾統 is the Qiantong era.
Goryeo had pledged to return those who had fled to its territory; he dispatched Asui and Shengkun to take charge of them.
Goryeo had pledged to return those who had fled to its territory; he dispatched Agua and Shengkun to take charge of them.
Goryeo violated the pact, executed both envoys, erected nine fortresses in the Halian region, and marched against the Jurchen with an army of tens of thousands.
Goryeo violated the pact, executed both envoys, erected nine fortresses in the Helan district, and marched against the Jurchen with an army of tens of thousands.
曷懶甸 is rendered Helan district elsewhere.
